# Phase 6 sweep tables (generated by model/sweeps_mlp.py)

Config C at 1 GHz after ISA v0.1.4 §11 (FIFO 8 unless stated, INP 5, WGT 32, request striping 2, operand broadcast). `CONFIG_C` = one stream with the four 64x64 arrays as one MMA unit; `CONFIG_C_CORE` = one array per core, channels shared. η_mfu (chip) charges all four arrays.
